messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "630", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score with sweeping strings and powerful brass swells, creating an intense cinematic atmosphere."}, {"id": "660", "observation": "A sustained, low-pitched brass note is followed by a deep, resonant impact and a brief, high-pitched electronic tone."}, {"id": "675", "observation": "A loud, sharp explosion occurs, followed by a brief silence and then a low, continuous humming sound."}, {"id": "705", "observation": "A person sighs, then a door opens and closes, followed by footsteps and a metallic click."}, {"id": "720", "observation": "A slow, melancholic cello melody plays over the sound of a horse trotting and a carriage rattling on a hard surface."}, {"id": "735", "observation": "A flute plays a melody over a string section, with a female voice singing a short phrase."}, {"id": "750", "observation": "No non-speech sounds are identifiable in the audio."}, {"id": "765", "observation": "A gentle piano melody plays softly in the background, accompanied by a subtle, sustained string pad."}]
